description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading and checking a platform's storage device partitions, specifically designed for the APM821xx platform. It defines functions to perform platform checks, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying related to firmware and partition management.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks the partition layout consistency between current disk and image, and determines if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by writing an image to the disk device, handling partition updates, and copying the partition UUID.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a specified partition.
